title: WARNING: MEMORY IS RUNNING LOW
headline: 5.4 GB memory left, 6.2 GB of swap in use.
detail: 4 client VMs are running. The laptop may lock up if this continues.

actions.label: Pause client VMs
actions.desc: Stops them instantly and resumes instantly. Frees no memory right away.

actions.label: Freeze client VMs
actions.desc: Saves them to disk and frees about 16 GB. Resume lab brings them back.

actions.label: Ignore 30 min
actions.desc: Does nothing and stays quiet for 30 minutes.
